assessments.reason: Problem clearly states redundant error nesting, patch removes one layer, test adapted to match new behavior.
Mathematical correction from exponentiation to multiplication per Ramanujan bound; test parametrization validates the fix.
Problem specifies DATEFROMPARTS function needed for T-SQL, patch adds transform, test validates output.
Problem requests guard when y_test is None and estimator unfitted, patch adds early return, test validates behavior.
Problem identifies incorrect equality between Terminal and Variable, patch restricts isinstance check, test validates concatenation.
Problem states invalid trajectories can be created, patch validates and falls back to original, test confirms behavior.
Problem identifies BVNone creation from SignExt/ZeroExt, patch adds proper operation handling, test validates correct length.
Problem identifies UnboundLocalError with empty list, patch initializes variables, test validates with empty objects.
Problem shows MRO broken in v4.46.0, patch adds early return guard, test validates MRO is preserved.
Problem identifies inconsistent behavior for zero polynomial primitive(), patch handles edge case, test validates.
Problem states env var ignored, patch reads from os.getenv(), tests validate both standard and pod identity paths.
Problem specifies PRIMARY KEY with sort option fails, patch enables ordered parsing, test validates DESC syntax.
Problem states poll doesn't retry after timeout, patch adds httpx.ReadTimeout to caught exceptions, test validates retry.
Problem identifies unit loss with scipy dev on nearest interpolation, patch fixes condition check, test validates units preserved.
Problem shows duplicate negative in union types, patch deduplicates by sorting and checking membership, test validates single appearance.
Patch completely rewrites parsing logic with complex nested conditions and implicit precedence assumptions that are hard to verify from the test.
Problem identifies relative URL handling missing, patch resolves relative paths, test validates cloning with relative submodule.
Problem shows inplace mul fails with dimensionless Quantity, patch changes identity to equality check, test validates behavior.
Test references external file tests/edls/adobe_dai109_test.txt which is not provided in patch content.
Problem states set_broker misses _update_fd_config call, patch adds it via helper, test validates context availability.
Problem identifies parameter semantics inverted, patch swaps formula terms, test expectations updated to match corrected behavior.
Problem shows ask() returns False when should return None, patch removes incorrect early return, test updated accordingly.
Problem shows missing parentheses with negative and low-precedence function, patch checks function precedence, test validates both cases.
Problem specifies missing hasconfig:remote.*.url pattern, patch adds regex and logic, test validates URL matching.
Problem states null field causes indicator parsing error, patch adds guards and handles empty values, test validates.
Problem identifies crash with commas in alt text, patch handles comma-separated alt text properly, test validates comma preservation.
Problem shows directory incorrectly yielded as key in ZipStore, patch adds strip() before comparison, test validates against unzipped.
Problem identifies ignored env var with hardcoded URL, patch uses os.getenv(), test validates env var honored.
Problem requests better error message for missing type parameter, patch adds early validation with helpful message, test validates.
Problem requests semantic rename from unsupported to unknown, patch consistently renames, tests updated.
Problem shows repr() displays help, patch separates __str__ from __repr__, test validates both forms.
Problem identifies crash on includeFunc directive, patch adds directive pattern and omits semicolon, test validates parsing.
Problem requests kwargs support for Context construction, patch enables kwargs in wrapper, test validates all calling styles.
Problem identifies missing enum support, patch detects enum type and converts to STRING with enum values, test validates.
Problem identifies unclosed file handles on large uploads, patch closes FileUpload objects, test validates closure.
Problem states repeated subscript references use same AST, patch adds deepcopy, test validates returned objects are different.
